vibe_rationale: Long-running maker and produce market with a genuine handmade rule, but tourist-heavy and generalist rather than curated culture.
fit_notes: Highest weekly footfall in Hobart and a natural sampling or stall spot for a Tasmanian-made wellness product. It is council-owned with no sponsors or published sponsorship program, so it is better for reach than for culture credibility and needs a council approach.
